module purpose: neorv32_uart is a bus-attached UART: a strobed bus write either stores control fields (enable, simulation mode, flow-control enable, prescaler, baud divisor, interrupt-condition enables, FIFO clear commands) or pushes a byte into a TX FIFO sub-unit; a transmitter pops each byte and serializes it onto uart_txd_o at the selected bit rate, optionally waiting for CTS; a receiver samples uart_rxd_i and pushes completed bytes into an RX FIFO sub-unit that bus reads pop; it also returns settings and status on bus reads, records receive overrun, and drives uart_rtsn_o, irq_rx_o, irq_tx_o and clkgen_en_o.

use-case flows.value: control fields (enable, simulation mode, flow-control enable, prescaler, baud divisor, five interrupt-condition enables, RX/TX FIFO clear commands) taken from a strobed bus write with addr(2) = '0'
a transmit byte pushed into the TX FIFO sub-unit by a strobed bus write with addr(2) = '1'
transmitter: TX FIFO byte loaded into the shift register, framed and shifted onto uart_txd_o at the bit rate set by prescaler tap and baud divisor, optionally waiting for CTS
receiver: uart_rxd_i synchronized, start bit detected, bits sampled into the shift register at the bit rate, and the completed byte pushed into the RX FIFO sub-unit
simulation-only character output: TX data writes copied to the simulation log when sim_mode_en_c holds and simulation mode is set
RX and TX interrupt requests raised from enabled FIFO conditions while the UART is enabled
receive overrun flag, set when a received byte is pushed while the RX FIFO is full
RTS flow-control output, raised under flow control when the UART is disabled or the RX FIFO is half full
stored control fields and status (FIFO levels, overrun, transmitter busy) returned on a strobed read with addr(2) = '0'
a received byte popped from the RX FIFO and returned on a strobed read with addr(2) = '1'
rstn_i low clears control fields, engines, interrupt outputs, overrun flag and RTS
FIFO flush while disabled, in simulation mode or on a clear command (clear commands self-clear each cycle); overrun cleared while disabled
